sc.intro: How ENEC Operations describes a healthy nuclear safety culture, the practices behind it and how anyone can raise a concern safely.
sc.informedBy: informed by INPO 12-012 and WANO PL 2013-01
sc.valuesIntro: The values ENEC Operations works by.

assessment.title: Independent assessment
assessment.body: Every two years; 89% of the workforce completed the 2024 survey.

panels.title: Monitoring panels
panels.body: Six-monthly nuclear safety culture monitoring panels.

steering.title: Steering committees
steering.body: Quarterly steering committees, pulse surveys and peer reviews.

majlis.title: Leader-led majlis
majlis.body: Leaders meet teams in majlis sessions to talk about safety.

fair.title: Safety Culture Fair
fair.body: An annual Nuclear Safety Culture Fair; daily safety messages during outages.

sc.huIntro: Core tools apply to everyone, supplemental workers included; conditional tools depend on the job.

hu.conditionalHint: When the job calls for them

sc.concernsBody: Anyone can raise a nuclear safety, quality or workplace concern through the Employee Concerns Program, which is independent and confidential. Kafa'a points you to the channels; it never takes or stores a concern.
sc.noGameBody: Safety culture is never scored or gamified in Kafa'a.
sc.huAiHint: When an AI or automated tool is in the loop

speak.intro: Kafa'a does not take concerns. Use one of the Employee Concerns Program channels ENEC publishes.
speak.protection: You are protected against harassment, intimidation, retaliation and discrimination for raising a concern.
speak.external: External option, run by the regulator.
speak.sourceNote: Channels as published in ENEC's Sustainability Report 2024 (p.86-87) and the UAE national report to the Convention on Nuclear Safety.
speak.anonTitle: Prefer not to give your name?
speak.anonBody: Say so when you contact the ECP. The ECP is confidential and independent, and explains which anonymity options apply to each channel. FANR's Report to Protect is a further, external option.

what.3: Anything you feel you cannot raise through your line.

speak.privacyBody: There is no form here, nothing you do on this page is recorded, analytics are switched off and Dalil is not available on this page.
speak.owner: Content owned by the Employee Concerns Program. Kafa'a editors cannot change it without ECP approval.

my.intro: One trait each week, human performance refreshers and reflection prompts. Your notes stay in this browser.
my.notesPrivacy: Notes are kept only in this browser. They are never sent to Kafa'a, your manager or anyone else.
my.noOe: No published lesson is linked to this trait yet.
my.huIntro: Refresh the tools you use every day. Nothing here is scored.
my.coreWhen: On every job, by everyone, including supplemental workers.
my.conditionalWhen: When the task, its risk or the procedure calls for it; your pre-job brief decides.
my.noGame: There are no points, streaks or badges for safety-culture learning.
my.aiTitle: With AI and automation in the loop
my.aiWhen: Whenever an AI or automated tool informs the job: a summary, a recommendation, a pre-filled entry or a translation.

oe.intro: Curated, de-identified lessons from this and other plants, each reviewed by the OE Screening Committee before publication.
oe.footer: Nothing security-sensitive is published. Lessons marked SAMPLE are illustrative.
oe.sentToReview: Sent to the OE Screening Committee
oe.publishBody: The lesson becomes visible to all staff with today's review date and the OE Screening Committee as reviewing body.
oe.checkDeid: It is de-identified: no names, crews, dates or places that identify people.
oe.checkNoSec: It contains nothing security-sensitive (no security arrangements, layouts or procedures).
oe.newHelp: Write in both languages. Drafts are visible only to editors and training staff until published.
oe.toAi: Safety culture with AI in the loop

ecp.intro: Referral metadata for the Employee Concerns Program team. The concern itself stays in the ECP system.
ecp.privacyBody: Kafa'a never holds the concern text or anything that identifies the person who raised it. Only the channel, category, anonymous flag, status and the ECP system reference are kept, and only you can see them.
ecp.targetNote: Demo target: triage within 2 UAE working days

out.referred_cap: Referred to the corrective action programme

ecp.closedNote: Closed referrals cannot be reopened in Kafa'a. Reopen the case in the ECP system.
ecp.confirmBody: Moves the referral from {from} to {to}. Only metadata is recorded; the step is written to the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.
ecp.noTextTitle: Do not type the concern here
ecp.noTextBody: Record only the metadata below. The concern, names and evidence belong in the ECP system.
ecp.sysRefHint: The case reference in the ECP system, for example ECP-SYS/2026-123.
ecp.anonHint: Tick when the person chose not to give their name to the ECP.

hu.linksStaff: {n} practice drills and lessons are linked to this tool; they open for signed-in staff.

ai.intro: AI and automated tools now summarise procedures, recommend maintenance and pre-fill checklists. A healthy safety culture treats their output like any other input: question it, check it against the controlled source and keep the decision with a person.

tile.classic: Classic tools with an AI angle
tile.classicSub: Every HU tool, revisited for AI
tile.lessonsSub: Public guidance, each with its source and date

ai.traitsTitle: Two traits, with AI in the loop
ai.traitsIntro: Questioning attitude and conservative decision-making, as they look when a tool informs the work.

ai.looksLike: What it looks like with AI

ai.fitIntro: Pick a moment where a tool is in the loop; the matching HU tools are listed with the reasons.

sit.mode: An automated system changed mode or display
sit.pressure: Time pressure and the tool says all clear

sit.disagree: The tool disagrees with your own reading

ai.fitNote: A fixed rule matches the moment's cues with each card's cues (AI-era cards first on a tie). It ranks content, never people, and stores nothing.
ai.classicTitle: The classic tools, with AI in the loop
ai.classicIntro: The HU tools you already use, and what each one means when a tool is involved.
ai.lessonsTitle: International lessons on automation and digital systems
ai.lessonsIntro: Lessons drawn from public international guidance. Read the source: each lesson is a short summary of it.
ai.noLessons: No lesson on automation is published yet.
ai.lessonsNote: Only public, international sources; no ENEC events. Lessons are reviewed by the OE Screening Committee before publication.

adm.intro: Content health for the HU and safety-culture lead: every card in English and Arabic, with at least one drill or lesson a reader can open, and every international lesson with a public source and date.

problem.description: Description missing in English or Arabic

adm.lessonsIntro: Edit lesson text and publication on Operating experience; sources are checked here.
adm.checkOk: Ready to save: complete in both languages and linked.
adm.confirmBody: The card is visible at once on the public safety-culture page and to all staff, with its drill and lesson links.
